column1: # Love Is All Around 2, Switch update 1.16.0.223 (v131072)
# Unity 2022.3.62f1 IL2CPP with FMOD, SDK 19.3.14. See README.md for the Mac playtest.
# Horizon load order; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resources. Unity starts StandardAllocator in virtual address memory and sets no heap.
# The 3.14 GiB startup reservation left too little contiguous space for Unity's font atlas allocations in the iPhone layout.
# Unity calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0. Build the pipeline bases for that mode.
